name: NHS inform — ADHD in children and young people
description: NHS inform guidance for Scotland on ADHD in children and young people, school/GP discussion, local assessment variation, waiting and private-assessment caveats.
intended_use: Use as the national Scotland-facing starting route when a child or young person may need ADHD support or assessment.
audience_or_context: Children and young people, parents/carers, schools and supporters in Scotland.
limitations: NHS inform explicitly states that there is no single standard ADHD assessment approach across Scotland; local health-board pathways differ.
School support and clinical diagnosis are distinct.
Private-assessment acceptance and later NHS treatment must be checked with the local health board and GP.
cost_or_access_notes: Publicly accessible online; NHS access depends on the local health board pathway.
conflicts_of_interest: NHS inform is Scotland's national health information service; ND Oracle records the official route without assuming local availability or outcome.

provenance.method: Current NHS inform child/young-person ADHD page checked on 2026-09-03 for school/GP support, health-board variation, waiting and private-assessment acceptance wording. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
